description: Send checkout and order events to Klaviyo and subscribe opt-ins
name: Klaviyo

images.title: Store events in Klaviyo
images.description: Checkouts and orders arrive in Klaviyo as metrics, with the order value, the items and the customer's profile.

images.title: Connected in a few minutes
images.description: Paste your Klaviyo API keys, choose the lists for opted-in customers and pick the events to send.

images.title: Opt-ins become Klaviyo subscribers
images.description: Customers who accept email or SMS marketing at checkout are subscribed in Klaviyo and added to your list.

images.title: Switch from the built-in integration
images.description: Install the app and turn off the built-in integration in one step. Metrics keep the same names and properties.
